spec_raw: Alert background color looks wrong (blended/washed out) for success, warning and error variants

spec_refined.title: Alert: fix background color blend for success, warning and error variants
spec_refined.description: The success, warning and error alert variants render with a blended/translucent background that does not match the design tokens. The background must be the correct solid token color per variant and theme.
acceptance_criteria: Success alert background matches the success token color (no blend) in all themes
Warning alert background matches the warning token color in all themes
Error alert background matches the error token color in all themes
Info variant is unchanged and all existing alert tests pass
spec_refined.technical_notes: Upstream fix was commit 87b26a41b (PR #1227); the rebreak reverts that commit on the experiment branch.
